skill_name: Construct an argument for why the COVID-19 pandemic acts as a natural experiment for scientists.
workflow: The COVID-19 pandemic acts as a natural experiment for scientists because of its global scale and the rapid dissemination of information through the internet and social media. It has provided the opportunity to observe how humans respond to a crisis and to collect data on a large scale.
